v-jesse-smith.text: (2022) At a chamber forum during a previous council run: "I believe in transformative change, I believe in transformative justice."

v-jesse-smith.text: (2022) Said local law enforcement and its leadership should know and represent the community they serve: "When I go into the Palmdale station, all I see is white males."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Council hopefuls outline positions (2022-10-13)

v-jesse-smith.text: (2022) Urged developing the Palmdale airport to attract businesses and said the city should do more to bring local firms into bidding for government contracts.

notes: Open seat (incumbent Andrea Alarcón did not file). No findable positions for cynthia-cyndi-d-garcia (no campaign site or coverage). Ector has only the LACDP endorsement. Smith has no 2026 platform online; his items come from his 2022 run. Searches used: 10.
